Le 24/01/2016.
COMPTE RENDU DE RADIOTHERAPIE CONCERNANT Madame RAYMOND, née LOPEZ Élise, née le 08/05/1952.
Indication: Cancer du sein droit. Stade T2N2M0 (IIIA), grade SBR III, taille tumorale de 40 mm, récepteurs ER positifs, PR négatifs, 4 ganglions positifs sur 9 examinés. Chirurgie selon stade T2N2M0, traitements adjuvants selon ER positifs et PR négatifs, décision de réunion de concertation pluridisciplinaire.
Préparation au traitement : Scanner dosimétrique TOSHIBA AQUILION LB (CTDI : 28,1 mGy ; PDL : 650,1 mGy.cm). Dosimétrie 3D conformationnelle. Double calcul UM. Dosimétrie in vivo réalisée le premier jour.
Traitement : Du 10 novembre 2015 au 24 janvier 2016 sur accélérateur Clinac Varian, étalement de 55 jours. Sein droit : par des champs tangentiels interne et externe aux photons de 6 MV avec et sans filtre : 50 Gy en 25 fractions. Surdosage du lit chirurgical par des champs tangentiels réduits aux photons de 6 et 23 MV : 16 Gy en 8 fractions. Volumes cibles : Sein droit : dose maximale de 54,8 Gy, dose moyenne de 51,2 Gy. Surdosage du lit chirurgical : dose maximale de 70,2 Gy, dose moyenne de 68,5 Gy. Organes à risque : Poumon droit : V20 = 18,2% (normal < 30%), V30 = 15,9% (normal < 20%), dose moyenne de 9,5 Gy. Cœur : dose moyenne de 2,7 Gy (contrainte < 4 Gy côté gauche).
Tolérance: Épidermite de grade 2 justifiant Diprosone et Ialuset. Douleurs du rachis lombaire justifiant un scanner révélant de l'arthrose avec pincement discal.
Décision en fin de traitement : Instauration du traitement par Tamoxifène, un comprimé par jour pendant 5 ans. Sera revue par le médecin référent dans six mois avec une mammographie.
Signé électroniquement par le Dr THOMAS Frédéric.

COMPTE RENDU DE RADIOTHERAPIE CONCERNANT Madame PETIT Joséphine, née le 03/09/1963.
Indication: Carcinome infiltrant du sein gauche stade T2N1M0 (IIB), grade SBR I, taille tumorale 35 mm, récepteurs ER positifs, PR positifs, 2 ganglions positifs sur 11 examinés. Chirurgie selon stade T2N1M0, traitements adjuvants selon ER positifs et PR positifs. Décision de réunion de concertation pluridisciplinaire.
Préparation au traitement : Scanner dosimétrique TOSHIBA AQUILION LB : CTDI : 27,3 mGy, PDL : 650 mGy.cm. Double calcul des unités motrices. Dosimétrie in vivo lors de la première et deuxième séance.
Réalisation du traitement : Radiothérapie externe conformationnelle 3D sur accélérateur Varian Clinac du 13 octobre au 24 novembre 2016, étalement de 42 jours. Sein gauche : 50 Gy en 25 fractions par quatre tangentiels internes et trois tangentiels externes aux photons de 6 et 23 MV avec et sans filtre. Boost du site tumoral initial : 16 Gy en 8 fractions par deux champs tangentiels internes et externes réduits aux photons de 23 et 6 MV. CTV sein gauche : dose max 53,8 Gy, dose moyenne 50,9 Gy. CTV boost : dose max 69,8 Gy, dose moyenne 66,9 Gy. OAR poumon gauche : V20 = 22,1% (normal < 30%), V30 = 19,8% (normal < 20%). OAR cœur : dose moyenne 2,1 Gy (contrainte < 4 Gy côté gauche).
Tolérance : La patiente a présenté une fatigue légère, un érythème cutané de grade I et une épidermite exfoliative minime des sillons.
En fin de traitement : Score OMS zéro, poids stable à 58 kg.
Prévisions : Poursuite de l'hormonothérapie adjuvante par Tamoxifène pendant cinq ans. Surveillances alternées.
Signé électroniquement par le Dr GAUTHIER Marie.

CTV boost : dose max 70,2 Gy, dose moyenne 69,3 Gy. OAR poumon gauche : V20 = 18,5% (normal < 30%), V30 = 15,2% (normal < 20%). OAR cœur : dose moyenne 3,1 Gy (contrainte < 4 Gy côté gauche).

REPORT ON THE COMPLETION OF RADIOtherapy FOR Mrs. LEMOINE, née RENARD Adrienne, born on 28/04/1971.

Diagnosis: Stage T1N1M0 (IIA), SBR grade II, tumor size of 20 mm, estrogen receptors positive, progesterone receptors positive, with 2 positive lymph nodes out of 18 examined.

Treatment plan: Following the surgical intervention according to stage T1N1M0, adjuvant treatments were decided upon based on positive estrogen and progesterone receptors. The decision for radiotherapy was made during a multidisciplinary consultation meeting.

Preparation for treatment: A dosimetric scan was performed using a Toshiba Aquilion LB scanner, with a CTDI of 24.6 mGy and PDL of 622 mGy.cm. Double calculation of motor units was done, along with in vivo dosimetry during the first session.

Implementation of treatment: External conformal radiotherapy was administered from 12 October to 29 November 2021, lasting 39 days. The right breast was treated with 50 Gy in 25 fractions through three internal and three external tangential fields using 6 MV photons, with and without a filter. The initial tumor site received an additional 16 Gy in 8 fractions via two reduced internal and external tangential fields using 23 MV photons. The CTV of the right breast had a maximum dose of 53 Gy and a mean dose of 50.9 Gy. The CTV boost had a maximum dose of 68 Gy and a mean dose of 66.5 Gy. Constraints for the right lung were respected, with V20 at 17.8% (below the normal threshold of 30%) and V30 at 15.8% (below the normal threshold of 20%).

Tolerance to treatment: The patient experienced grade I erythema and mild skin desquamation in the mammary sulcus. No significant pulmonary toxicity was observed.

End-of-treatment assessment: At the end of the treatment, the patient's performance status according to the WHO scale was zero, weight remained stable at 60 kg, and there were no residual toxicities.

Future plans: Adjuvant hormone therapy with Tamoxifen will be initiated for five years. Further follow-up appointments have been scheduled.

Therapeutic Context: Surgery according to T2N2M0 stage, adjuvant treatments according to positive estrogen and progesterone receptors, decision made during multidisciplinary consultation meeting.

Indication: Breast carcinoma with the following characteristics: T1N3M0 (Stage IIIC), SBR grade III, tumor size of 17 mm, estrogen receptors negative, progesterone receptors negative, and 19 positive lymph nodes out of 22 examined.

Treatment delivery: External beam radiotherapy was administered from 12 October to 29 November 2021, lasting for 39 days. The right breast was treated with 50 Gy in 25 fractions using three internal and three external tangential fields with photons of 6 MV energy, with and without a filter. Boost to the initial tumor site was delivered with 16 Gy in 8 fractions using two reduced internal and external tangential fields with photons of 23 and 6 MV. The CTV of the right breast received a maximum dose of 53 Gy and an average dose of 50.9 Gy. The boost CTV received a maximum dose of 68 Gy and an average dose of 66.5 Gy. Constraints for organs at risk were respected: right lung V20 = 17.8% (threshold < 30%), V30 = 15.8% (threshold < 20%).

Tolerance to treatment: The patient experienced grade I erythema and mild skin desquamation. No other significant adverse effects were reported.

End-of-treatment assessment: Performance status according to WHO criteria was zero. Weight remained stable at 68 kg. Residual toxicities included grade I erythema and minimal skin desquamation.

Future plans: Adjuvant hormone therapy with Tamoxifen will be initiated for five years. Regular follow-up visits are scheduled.

REPORT OF RADIO-THERAPY FOR Mrs. GOMEZ Manon, born on 02/01/1956.
Indication: Infiltrating carcinoma of the right breast, stage T1N1M0 (IIA), histological grade SBR II, tumor size 17 mm, estrogen receptors positive, progesterone receptors positive, 1 positive lymph node out of 16 examined.

Preparation for treatment: Dosimetric scan TOSHIBA AQUILION LB (CTDI: 22.1 mGy; PDL: 520.2 mGy.cm). Double calculation of motor units. In vivo dosimetry performed on the first day.
Treatment implementation: External conformal radiotherapy 3D on Varian Clinac accelerator from October 12 to December 17, 2018, with a duration of 65 days. Right breast: 50 Gy in 25 fractions using internal and external tangential fields with 6 MV photons with and without filter. Boost on surgical bed: 16 Gy in 8 fractions using reduced internal and external tangential fields with 23 MV photons. Target volumes: Right breast: maximum dose of 52.2 Gy, average dose of 50.9 Gy. Surgical bed boost: maximum dose of 68.2 Gy, average dose of 66.8 Gy. Organs at risk: Right lung: V20 = 18.2% (normal < 30%), V30 = 15.9% (normal < 20%), average dose of 9.2 Gy.
Tolerance: The patient experienced grade 1 erythema and mild skin desquamation.
End-of-treatment assessment: Performance status OMS 0, weight stable at 60 kg, residual toxicity limited to grade 1 skin reaction.
Future plans: Adjuvant hormonal therapy with Tamoxifen for five years. Alternating follow-up visits are scheduled.

NARRATIVE REPORT OF THE END OF RADIOTHERAPY FOR Mrs. LOISEAU, née LE GALL Henriette, born on 17/09/1958.

The patient presented with a carcinoma of the left breast, classified as T2N2M0 (Stage IIIA), with a tumor size of 23 mm, positive estrogen receptors (ER), positive progesterone receptors (PR), and 8 positive lymph nodes out of 26 examined. The histological grade was determined to be SBR II.

Following a multidisciplinary consultation meeting, it was decided to perform surgery according to the T2N2M0 stage, followed by adjuvant treatments based on the positivity of ER and PR receptors.

Preparation for radiotherapy included a dosimetric scan using a Toshiba Aquilion LB scanner, with a CTDI of 27.1 mGy and a PDL of 650 mGy.cm. Double calculation of motor units was performed, along with in vivo dosimetry during the first session.

Radiotherapy treatment was delivered from February 11th to March 13th, 2019, over a period of 33 days. It consisted of external beam radiation therapy using a Varian Clinac accelerator. The left breast received a total dose of 50 Gy in 25 fractions, administered through three internal and three external tangential fields with photons of 6 MV energy, with and without a filter. Additionally, a boost dose of 16 Gy in 8 fractions was given to the initial tumor site using two reduced internal and external tangential fields with photons of 23 and 6 MV.

Organ at risk constraints were respected, with the right lung having a V20 of 18.2% (normal < 30%) and a V30 of 15.1% (normal < 20%). The mean heart dose was limited to 2.1 Gy (constraint < 4 Gy).

During treatment, the patient experienced grade 1 erythema and mild fatigue, which were managed accordingly.

At the end of the radiotherapy treatment, the patient's performance status was scored as 0 according to the WHO scale, and her weight remained stable at 65 kg. Mild residual skin toxicity was observed.

Future therapeutic plans include adjuvant hormonal therapy with Tamoxifen for five years, starting one month after the completion of radiotherapy. Regular follow-up visits will be scheduled every six months.

REPORT ON THE COMPLETION OF RADIOTHERAPY FOR Mrs. JOUBERT Maggie, born on 23/10/1961.
Indication: Breast-conserving surgery for a stage T4N3M0 (IIIC) breast carcinoma, with a histological grade SBR II, tumor size of 55 mm, positive estrogen receptors, positive progesterone receptors, and 26 out of 26 examined lymph nodes being positive. Decision made during a multidisciplinary meeting to proceed with adjuvant treatments according to the positive hormone receptor status and the advanced stage of the disease.
Preparation for treatment: Dosimetric scan performed using a Toshiba Aquilion LB scanner, with a CTDI of 27.3 mGy and a PDL of 630 mGy.cm. Double calculation of monitor units. In vivo dosimetry carried out on the first day of treatment.
Treatment delivery: External beam radiotherapy was delivered from 15/01/2017 to 28/02/2017 using a Varian Clinac accelerator. The total treatment duration was 44 days. The left breast received 50 Gy in 25 fractions through three internal and three external tangential fields using 6 MV and 23 MV photons, with and without a wedge filter. The boost area received an additional 16 Gy in 8 fractions through two reduced internal and external tangential fields using 23 MV photons. The CTV breast mean dose was 51.2 Gy, while the CTV boost mean dose was 67.3 Gy. Constraints for organs at risk were respected, with the right lung having a V20 of 18.2% (below the threshold of 30%) and a V30 of 15.9% (below the threshold of 20%), and the heart receiving a mean dose of 2.1 Gy (within the constraint of less than 4 Gy).
Tolerance: The patient experienced grade 1 erythema and mild fatigue during treatment.
End-of-treatment assessment: Performance status score of 0, weight stable at 58 kg, and residual skin toxicity.
Future plans: Adjuvant hormonal therapy will be initiated with Tamoxifen for five years. Follow-up visits are scheduled every six months.

REPORT ON THE COMPLETION OF RADIO-THERAPY FOR Mrs. VAILLANT Anouk, born on 08/05/1976.

Indication: Breast carcinoma with the following characteristics: T3N2M0 (IIIA), SBR grade II, tumor size of 52 mm, estrogen receptors positive, progesterone receptors positive, 4 positive lymph nodes out of 24 examined. Decision made during a multidisciplinary consultation meeting for surgery according to the T3N2M0 stage, followed by adjuvant treatments based on the positive hormone receptors.

Preparation for treatment: Dosimetric scan performed using a Toshiba Aquilion LB scanner, with a CTDI of 26.4 mGy and a PDL of 610 mGy.cm. Dual calculation of motor units. In vivo dosimetry conducted during the first session.

Treatment delivery: External conformal radiotherapy administered from May 11th to June 26th, 2020, over a period of 35 days. The right breast was treated with two internal and three external tangential fields using photons of 6 and 23 MV energy, with and without a filter. Total prescribed dose of 50 Gy delivered in 25 fractions. Boost to the initial tumor site with two internal and external reduced fields using photons of 23 and 6 MV energy, delivering an additional 16 Gy in 8 fractions. Mean dose to the CTV of the right breast was 51.2 Gy, and the maximum dose was 55.6 Gy. Mean dose to the boost CTV was 67.3 Gy, and the maximum dose was 70.8 Gy. Constraints to the right lung were respected, with V20 equal to 19.5% (normally less than 30%) and V30 equal to 16.2% (normally less than 20%).

Tolerance to treatment: The patient experienced grade 1 erythema and mild skin desquamation in the mammary fold, managed with topical corticosteroids.

End-of-treatment assessment: Performance status score of 0, weight stable at 60 kg, and residual grade 1 skin toxicity.

Future plans: Adjuvant hormonal therapy with aromatase inhibitors will be initiated for five years. Close monitoring is recommended every three months.

REPORT ON THE COMPLETION OF RADIOtherapy FOR Mrs. CLERC Margaret, born on 06/03/1962.

Diagnosis: Stage T1N1M0 (IIA), histological grade SBR II, tumor size of 10 mm, estrogen receptors positive, progesterone receptors positive, 1 positive lymph node out of 2 examined.

Therapeutic context: Surgery according to stage T1N1M0, adjuvant treatments based on positive estrogen and progesterone receptors, decision made at a multidisciplinary consultation meeting.

Preparation for treatment: Dosimetric scan using Toshiba Aquilion LB, CTDI of 26.5 mGy, PDL of 620 mGy.cm. Double calculation of motor units. In vivo dosimetry performed during the first session.

Treatment delivery: External beam radiotherapy from November 12th to December 29th, 2015, over a period of 35 days. Right breast: 50 Gy delivered in 25 fractions through three internal and three external tangential fields with photons of 6 MV energy, with and without a filter. Boost to the initial tumor site: 16 Gy delivered in 8 fractions through two reduced internal and external tangential fields with photons of 23 and 6 MV. CTV right breast: maximum dose of 52.8 Gy, average dose of 50.7 Gy. CTV boost: maximum dose of 68.8 Gy, average dose of 66.3 Gy. Constraints on organs at risk: Right lung V20 = 18.2% (normal < 30%), V30 = 15.5% (normal < 20%).

Tolerance to treatment: The patient experienced grade 1 erythema and mild skin desquamation in the mammary folds, managed with topical corticosteroids.

End-of-treatment assessment: Performance status OMS zero, weight stable at 55 kg, residual toxicity limited to grade 1 skin reactions.

Future therapeutic plans: Adjuvant hormone therapy with Tamoxifen for five years. Scheduled follow-up visits.
